「What could be

「I see...」

{spk}ロジャー　　
「A sneak attack?

{spk}リュウビ　　
「A vile tactic, unworthy

「自分の力を　信じるんだ！

{spk}{FF1F}
「Believe in your own strength!

「‥‥反乱軍‥‥どもが！

　‥‥近いうちに‥‥必ずな！」

{spk}空挺部隊長　
「...You rebel... scum! You will...
 die...! ...Soon... I swear it!」
pages: "...You rebel... scum! You will... die...! ...Soon... I swear it!"

「オレ達は　敵のワナを　はねのけた
　何の事はない　いつも通りの
　ありふれた　戦いだった‥‥」

「ありふれた　戦いか‥‥

「結局は　連邦も　オレたちも

「だが　それもまた　いいだろう

 enemy's trap.」

「It was nothing special, just

「An ordinary battle, huh...」

「Before we knew it,

「Until this endless
 journey is over.」

jp:

「殺すなら　殺せ！
　オレは　自分のした事を
　間違っているとは　思わん」
{next}
「さあ　どうした！？」
en:
{spk}連邦兵　　　
「If you're going to kill
 me, kill me! I don't think
 what I did was wrong.」
{next}
「Well, what are
 you waiting for!?」
pages: "If you're going to kill me, kill me! I don't think what I did was wrong." || "Well, what are you waiting for!?"
"No, {hero}!" || "If {FF31} were here, who knows what she'd say, but I'm sure she'd hate it!"

jp:
{spk}{FF1F}
「そうだな‥‥」
en:
{spk}{FF1F}
「You're right...」
pages: "You're right..."

jp:
{spk}連邦兵　　　
「甘いな！　それで　わが連邦を
　倒せると　思ったら
　大きな間違いだぞ　反乱軍め！」
{next}
「だが‥‥　礼は言う‥‥
　‥‥すまなかった‥‥」
en:
{spk}連邦兵　　　
「Soft! If you think that's how
 you'll beat our Federation,
 you're dead wrong, rebel!」
{next}
「But... thank you... ...I'm sorry...」
pages: "Soft! If you think that's how you'll beat our Federation, you're dead wrong, rebel!" || "But... thank you... ...I'm sorry..."

jp:
{spk}{FF1F}
「殺す気には　なれん」
en:
{spk}{FF1F}
「I don't feel like killing you.」
pages: "I don't feel like killing you."

jp:
{spk}連邦兵　　　
「さっさと　行くがいい！
　オレは　あくまで　連邦の兵士！
　一人でも　この地を　守りぬく！」
{next}
「‥‥気をつけろよ　この
　くそったれ　反乱軍ども！」
en:
{spk}連邦兵　　　
「Go on, get going! I'm a
 Federation soldier to the
 end! I'll defend this land,」
{next}
「even if I'm the only one left!」
{next}
「...Watch yourselves,
 you damn rebels!」
pages: "Go on, get going! I'm a Federation soldier to the end! I'll defend this land, even if I'm the only one left!" || "...Watch yourselves, you damn rebels!"

jp:
「足の向くままに　オレたちは
　西の海に　ぽつりと　うかぶ
　ちっぽけな島へと　やってきた」
{next}
「船もなく　あさせを歩いて
　たどり着ける　この島には
　さすがに　連邦の姿は　ない」

「Going where our feet took
 us, we reached a tiny island
 alone in the western sea.」
{next}
「You can reach this island
 without a ship, just by
 wading through the shallows,」
{next}
「and sure enough, there was
 no sign of the Federation.」
pages: "Going where our feet took us, we reached a tiny island alone in the western sea." || "You can reach this island without a ship, just by wading through the shallows, and sure enough, there was no sign of the Federation."

en: 「The Forgotten Island」
pages: "The Forgotten Island"

en:
{spk}{FF28}
「Oh, is that a house?
 So people live even
 on an island like this.」
{next}
「Let's go see. We might
 get some information.」
pages: "Oh, is that a house? So people live even on an island like this." || "Let's go see. We might get some information."

en:
{spk}{FF28}
「...{hero}, this statue
 looks just like the
 ancient Zodiac Gods.」
pages: "...{hero}, this statue looks just like the ancient Zodiac Gods."

{spk}{FF1F}
「‥‥黄道十二神？」

{spk}{FF1F}
「...Zodiac Gods?」
pages: "...Zodiac Gods?"

The sun had already vanished, and men trembled in a night without end. || Ah, but behold! {spk}{FF1F}
「テティス？　どうした？」

{spk}{FF1F}
「Thetis? What's wrong?」
pages: "Thetis? What's wrong?"

{spk}{FF28}
「What's happening? All of a
 sudden, I'm remembering
 all sorts of things...」
pages: "What's happening? All of a sudden, I'm remembering all sorts of things..."

{spk}黄道十二神　
「わが像の前に　立ちし者よ
　なんじは　世界のやみを　はらう者か？」

「You who stand before my
 statue... are you the one to
 dispel this world's darkness?」
pages: "You who stand before my statue... are you the one to dispel this world's darkness?"

{spk}{FF1F}
「何だ？　石像が　しゃべっている？」

{spk}{FF1F}
「What? The statue is talking?」
pages: "What? The statue is talking?"

{spk}{FF28}
「It's not a voice. The
 meaning is flying
 straight into my mind!?」
pages: "It's not a voice. The meaning is flying straight into my mind!?"

jp:
{spk}黄道十二神　
「われは　星々の流れに　したがって
　この世界の　運命の流れを
　つかさどる　十二の神の一人　なり」
{next}
「そなたに　わが力をたくす
　われら　十二の神の代理人として
　この世の　ながれを　是正せよ」

{spk}黄道十二神　
「I am one of the twelve gods
 who, following the stars,
 govern the flow of fate.」
{next}
「To thee I entrust my power.
 As agent of us twelve
 gods, set the world aright.」
pages: "I am one of the twelve gods who, following the stars, govern the flow of fate." || "To thee I entrust my power. As agent of us twelve gods, set the world aright."

{spk}{FF1F}
「Sorry. I don't believe in gods.」
pages: "Sorry. I don't believe in gods."

{spk}黄道十二神　
「あらがう事は　できぬ

　初めて行なわれる事を　知れ」

{spk}黄道十二神　
「Thou canst not resist. Know
 that harmony is achieved
 only through two powers.」
pages: "Thou canst not resist. Know that harmony is achieved only through two powers."

{spk}{FF1F}
「二つの‥‥力？」
en:
{spk}{FF1F}
「Two... powers?」
pages: "Two... powers?"

{spk}黄道十二神　
「なんじは　世界にちらばりし

　その全ての力を　束ねるのだ」

「さすれば　われらは　なんじに

「Seek out the twelve gods'

「Then shall we grant
 thee true power...」

jp:
{spk}村長　　　　
「この島にも　昔は　ようけ人がおった
　だが　若者は　みな連邦の兵に取られ
　今では　このありさまじゃ‥‥」
{next}
「もし　兵になるのを　きょひすれば
　殺されて　しまうからのぅ‥‥
　この村でも　殺された者が　おる」
en:
{spk}村長　　　　
「There used to be plenty of
 folk on this island too. But
 the Federation took all the」
{next}
「young ones as soldiers,
 and now look at it...」
{next}
「Refuse to become a soldier,
 and they kill you, you see...」
{next}
「Some folk in this
 village were killed too.」
pages: "There used to be plenty of folk on this island too. But the Federation took all the young ones as soldiers, and now look at it..." || "Refuse to become a soldier, and they kill you, you see...{next}Some folk in this village were killed too."

jp:
{spk}村長　　　　
「耳をすませば　今でも　聞こえる
　大りょうを　祝う
　村の　若者たちの　声がな‥‥」
en:
{spk}村長　　　　
「If I listen closely, I can still
 hear them... the voices of the
 village youngsters」
{next}
「celebrating a big catch...」
pages: "If I listen closely, I can still hear them... the voices of the village youngsters celebrating a big catch..."

jp:
{spk}バアさん　　
「わしは　この島で　海から
　とどけられる　さまざまな
　情報に　耳をすませておる」
{next}
「何か　聞きたい事は　あるか？」
{next}
　暗黒のカベについて
　大陸の南について
　最終兵器について

en:
{spk}バアさん　　
「I sit on this island,
 dearie, listening to all the
 news the sea brings me.」
{next}
「Is there anything
 you'd like to ask?」
{next}
　About the dark wall
　About the south
　About the ultimate weapon
{FF14:00C3}{end}
pages: "I sit on this island, dearie, listening to all the news the sea brings me." || "Is there anything you'd like to ask?" || About the dark wall\nAbout the south\nAbout the ultimate weapon

jp:
{spk}バアさん　　
「そいつは　連邦の　王都をかこむ
　強力な　結界の事じゃな‥‥」
{next}
「その黒きカベは　いかなる剣も
　魔法も　受けつけぬ　恐るべき
　古代の技術で　作られておる」
{next}
「これを　破れるのは　その昔
　黄道十二神が　人に与えた
　伝説の　報奨の剣のみじゃ」
en:
{spk}バアさん　　
「Ah, that'd be the powerful
 barrier around the
 Federation's royal capital...」
{next}
「That black wall was made
 with fearsome ancient arts.」
{next}
「No sword or spell
 can touch it.」
{next}
「The only thing that can
 break it is the legendary
 Sword of Bounty, which the」
{next}
「Zodiac Gods gave
 to man long ago.」
pages: "Ah, that'd be the powerful barrier around the Federation's royal capital..." || "That black wall was made with fearsome ancient arts.{next}No sword or spell can touch it." || "The only thing that can break it is the legendary Sword of Bounty, which the Zodiac Gods gave to man long ago."

jp:
「‥‥そう　ちょうど
　今　あんたが　持っている
　その剣に　よく　にておるな」
en:
「...Yes, it looks very much
 like that sword you're
 carrying right now.」
pages: "...Yes, it looks very much like that sword you're carrying right now."

jp:
{spk}バアさん　　
「ここから　ずっと　南へ進むと
　やがて　廃墟の半島と
　よばれる　みさきへ　たどり着く」
{next}
「連邦の中心　オルドバよりも
　さらに古い　はるかな昔‥‥」
{next}
「廃墟の半島では　とんでもない
　力を持った　文明が
　栄えておった‥‥という話じゃ」
{next}
「その文明も　今の連邦と　同じく
　神々の兵器を　ほり出したそうじゃが
　使い方を　あやまったらしい‥‥」
{next}
「文明は　わずか一夜で　消えて
　今では　そのざんがいを
　残すのみ‥‥となったのじゃ」
en:
{spk}バアさん　　
「Head far south from here,
 and you'll come to a cape
 called Ruin Peninsula.」
{next}
「Long, long ago, even
 before Ordoba, the
 heart of the Federation...」
{next}
「they say a civilization
 with tremendous power
 flourished on Ruin Peninsula...」
{next}
「Like the Federation today,
 that civilization dug up the
 weapons of the gods, but it」
{next}
「seems they used
 them wrong...」
{next}
「The civilization vanished
 in a single night, and now
 only its ruins remain...」

jp:
{spk}バアさん　　
「機神じゃと？　あんな物は
　暗黒十二神の　力の
　わずかな　一部でしかない」
{next}
「言ってみれば　真の　最終兵器の
　力を　まねした　ささやかな
　オモチャみたいな物じゃ‥‥」
{next}
「最終兵器は　暗黒十二神が
　束ねられた　真の姿
　恐るべき　はかいの神なのじゃ」
{next}
「はかいの神は　神の名を持つ　悪魔
　この世の　あらゆる物を
　跡形もなく　はかいしつくす‥‥」

{spk}バアさん　　
「Machine Gods, you say?」
{next}
「Those things are only a
 tiny part of the power
 of the Twelve Dark Gods.」
{next}
「You might call them little
 toys that ape the power of
 the true ultimate weapon...」
{next}
「The ultimate weapon is the
 true form of the Twelve
 Dark Gods bound together, a」
{next}
「fearsome god of destruction.」
{next}
「The god of destruction is a
 devil bearing a god's name. It
 will destroy everything in」
{next}
「this world without a trace...」

jp:
{spk}老人　　　　
「わしの息子は　連邦に入るのを
　断ったために　殺されてしまった
　どうか　カタキを　とってくれ」
{next}
「これは　大した物では　ないが
　祖先から　伝わる　武器じゃ
　これを使って　どうか連邦を‥‥」
en:
{spk}老人　　　　
「They killed my son, I tell
 you, for refusing to join
 the Federation. Avenge him!」
{next}
「It isn't much, mind you, but
 it's a weapon handed down
 from our ancestors. Use it, I」
{next}
「beg you, and take
 down the Federation...」
pages: "They killed my son, I tell you, for refusing to join the Federation. Avenge him!" || "It isn't much, mind you, but it's a weapon handed down from our ancestors. Use it, I beg you, and take down the Federation..."

en:
{spk}{FF28}
「{hero}...!? This old man...?」
pages: "{hero}...!? This old man...?"
"Yeah, let's leave him be. I'll avenge his son."

jp:
「王都の南を　回りこむように
　進む　オレたちは　やがて
　ぜつ望の湖へと　たどり着いた」
{next}
「この湖の　ほとりで　人は
　おのれの無力さに　なげき
　ぜつ望のふちに　立つのだと言う」
en:
「Circling south of the
 royal capital, we at last
 reached Lake Despair.」
{next}
「They say that on the shores
 of this lake, people mourn
 their own powerlessness and」
